title: Information Cascades in the Laboratory

studies.implementation_scope: The runtime implements the three baseline sessions. Reported aggregate findings below pool all six symmetric sessions, including public-draw variants.

findings.main_hypothesis: Participants follow a rational cascade when the public evidence dominates a conflicting private signal.
Participants use public information efficiently rather than relying only on their private draw.
When the posterior is tied, participants generally follow their private signal rather than the preceding public decision.

required_tests.description: All decisions are valid A/B choices and each decision receives only its private signal plus prior public choices.
Compare agent cascade-following behavior with the reported symmetric aggregate rate of 41/56.
required_tests.scope_warning: The published rate includes public-draw sessions that are not implemented in the baseline runtime.

source_limitations: The paper states that a complete data appendix was available from the authors on request; it was not included in the public PDF.
The exact public-draw schedule for every symmetric variant is not fully specified in the article.
No participant-level original data are included, so numerical alignment is evaluated as a behavioral benchmark rather than an exact rerun.
